description_en: Queries the usage of a reserved CIDR block for a vSwitch
description_zh: 查询交换机预留网段的用量
kebab_example: aliyun vpc get-vswitch-cidr-reservation-usage --vswitch-cidr-reservation-id vcr-bp1m12saqteraw3rp0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetVSwitchCidrReservationUsage

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the reserved CIDR block for a vSwitch that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的交换机预留网段的实例ID
parameters.name: vswitch_cidr_reservation_id

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token. Valid values:
Leave this parameter empty for the first query or if no subsequent query is required.
If a subsequent query is required, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the vSwitch.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
交换机所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

CidrReservationUsages.description_en: The list of allocated reserved CIDR blocks for a vSwitch
CidrReservationUsages.description_zh: 已分配使用的交换机预留网段列表

items.description_en: The list of allocated reserved CIDR blocks for a vSwitch
items.description_zh: 已分配使用的交换机预留网段列表

IpPrefixCidr.description_en: The prefix CIDR block allocated from the current reserved CIDR block for a vSwitch to an elastic network interface (ENI)
IpPrefixCidr.description_zh: 从当前预留网段中已分配给弹性网卡使用的前缀网段（prefix）

IpPrefixId.description_en: The instance ID of the reserved CIDR block allocated by prefix
IpPrefixId.description_zh: 按段分配的预留网段实例ID

ResourceId.description_en: The instance ID of the elastic network interface (ENI) allocated from the reserved CIDR block for a vSwitch
ResourceId.description_zh: 从预留网段分配使用的弹性网卡的实例ID
ResourceId.title_en: 前缀网段绑定资源的实例Id
ResourceId.title_zh: 前缀网段绑定资源的实例Id

ResourceType.description_en: The instance type allocated from the reserved CIDR block for a vSwitch. Valid values: NetworkInterface, which indicates an elastic network interface (ENI)
ResourceType.description_zh: 预留网段分配使用的实例类型。取值：NetworkInterface，弹性网卡类型
ResourceType.title_en: 前缀网段绑定资源的类型
ResourceType.title_zh: 前缀网段绑定资源的类型

VSwitchCidrReservationId.description_en: The instance ID of the reserved CIDR block for a vSwitch
VSwitchCidrReservationId.description_zh: 交换机预留网段的实例ID

VSwitchId.description_en: The ID of the vSwitch to which the reserved CIDR block belongs
VSwitchId.description_zh: 预留网段所属的交换机ID

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, no subsequent query exists.
If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
